objects.title: stem_1 = Q[x]/(x^3-x-1), degree 3, disc -23, S_3 closure (= K_1 = K_3)
objects.note: stem_1 = K_1 (headline cubic) = K_3 (VR-42 point search) are the SAME field: Q[x]/(x^3-x-1), disc -23, non-Galois degree 3, S_3 closure. rank E(stem_1)=3. NOTE: distinct quartic K_1=Q[x]/(x^4-x-1) disc -283 in S_4 prose context is a DIFFERENT object, not this canonical K_1. Also distinct from K_1~ (the degree-6 S_3 closure = Omega_1, the splitting field). stem_1 = the degree-3 ROOT field, NOT Galois (closure = K_1~ = Omega_1). [Note de-staled per VR-1027: CLAUDE.md's old 'stem_k = splitting field' was the mislabel, corrected in VR-1023/1026 to stem_k = root field, Omega_k = splitting field.]

objects.title: Omega_k = Galois closure (= SPLITTING FIELD) of G_k; the arboreal tower's splitting field, [Omega_k:Q]=|G_k| (Omega_2 deg 1296)
objects.note: The SPLITTING FIELD / Galois closure of G_k -- the CORRECT central object the 'stem_k = splitting field' mislabel confused (VR-95 §2.1; corrected VR-1023/1026/1027, AUDIT-215/217). Gal(Omega_k/Q)=G_k (subset W_k=S_3^{wr k}, full-wreath equality proven k<=3 (k=3 direct for the phi-tower via VR-1059 split-prime cube certificate + RF-54 CONCUR; C_3-independence of the relative cubics the residual, open+parked k>=4 per VR-1059 sec 6.3; transitivity + a transposition is necessary-not-sufficient per r15 v15 sec 6.6), conjectured all k -- VR-1026 + r15 v15 + VR-1059/RF-54 + VR-1060). E(stem_k)=E(Omega_k)^H, H=Gal(Omega_k/stem_k), |H|=144 at k=2. Distinct from stem_k (the degree-3^k ROOT field, NOT Galois for any k>=1). Omega_1 == K_1~ (the degree-6 S_3 closure; see that entry) -- Omega_1 aliases live on K_1~ to avoid a resolution collision. Added per the VR-1027 §5 deferred /ontology-reconcile follow-up (the genuinely-missing tower entity).

objects.title: K~_1 = Q[a]/(a^6-6a^4+9a^2+23), degree 6, S_3 Galois closure of stem_1, disc -12167=-23^3
objects.note: TILDE COLLISION: differs from K_1 only by a U+0303 combining tilde. Galois closure (splitting field) of x^3-x-1; HCF of Q(sqrt-23); Gal=S_3; rank E(K~_1)=3 (= rank E(stem_1)=3, same rank object). K_1~ == Omega_1 (the k=1 splitting field): Omega_1 surface forms (Ω_1/Ω₁) resolve here, NOT to the generic Omega_k entity (VR-1027 §5).
